title: Marketplace Return History Addition on Drive Up Changed-Mind Returns
content:
**Rule.** On a changed-mind Drive Up return of an electronics-class line of a Northgate Same-Day Delivery order under **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, a restocking addition is set by the customer's Northgate Marketplace return requests on the records of Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee: those made for a change of mind, whatever the seller answered, whose request date falls fewer than twelve whole months before the return date.

| Such Northgate Marketplace return requests | Restocking addition |
|---|---|
| two or more | 5 percent |
| one | 2 percent |
| none | nothing |

**Points of judgement.** A Marketplace return request for a defective item is not counted; a changed-mind request the seller declined is counted; a changed-mind request made twelve or more whole months before the return date is not counted.
